name: captions-style
description: The signature burned-in caption look for short-form explainer: a black rounded box behind the words, each word animating in on-beat as it is spoken. Uses word-level WhisperX timings — no re-transcription.
$comment_highlight_mode: active-word = the currently-spoken word is tinted with highlight_color (karaoke). Set to 'none' for static white.
